insights.summary: Initial setup feedback points to discoverability and completion problems with invitations, configuration controls, and launch guidance (H201–H204).
insights.pm_recommendation: Hypothesis: test a clearer guided setup sequence that surfaces invitation steps, timezone configuration, and connector-order guidance.

insights.summary: Routine notifications are duplicated, too frequent, or lack suitable controls and digest options (H205–H208).
insights.pm_recommendation: Hypothesis: investigate event-level deduplication, configurable frequency/opt-out controls, and low-priority digests.

insights.summary: Reporting friction includes export/filter mismatch, hard-to-find breakdowns, resetting date filters, and unclear chart time-zone semantics (H209–H212).
insights.pm_recommendation: Hypothesis: validate export-filter consistency, persist report filter state, improve breakdown discoverability, and label chart time zones.

insights.summary: Invoices and renewal pricing lack clear attribution or itemized explanations, and users question continued charges and adjustments (H213–H216).
insights.pm_recommendation: Hypothesis: explore itemized invoice details, charge attribution, and plain-language explanations for prorations and adjustments.

insights.summary: External-data workflows report duplicated history or contacts, stale values, and missing downstream ticket delivery (H217–H220).
insights.pm_recommendation: Hypothesis: examine reconnect/retry idempotency, refresh behavior, and end-to-end delivery observability.
